_doc: #1484 THE file-type to viewer/editor mapping, as data. `viewers[].id` names the lib that owns the file (wysiwyg = libs:wysiwyg, media = libs:media-viewer, pdf = libs:pdf, odf = libs:odf); `editable` says whether that viewer has an Edit mode (media is view only); `formats` maps a format the viewer understands to the extensions that carry it. `unsupported` is checked FIRST: the Microsoft Office formats are refused on purpose and answer `unsupported format`. A name no entry matches also answers unsupported. Adding a type is a data edit.
